text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 20, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "count", "span": "20 minutes for the oil to heat up to 300 degrees"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 40, "unit": "percent", "kind": "count", "span": "40% longer for the oil to heat up"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 5, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "count", "span": "5 minutes less time to cook"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "extra minutes beyond the first 20, from the 40%-longer stage"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "total minutes to warm the oil to 400 degrees"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "minutes it takes to cook (5 less than warm-up time)"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "total time from starting the oil to having cooked chicken"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "total minutes from starting the oil to having cooked chicken"}, "dismissed": []}
